system.description:
• Effect: A new Performance option, costing 2 uses: inspire one creature with greatness; you may choose yourself.
  • For the encounter it may reroll one attack roll or save each round, rolling it the way it was first rolled, and must keep the new roll.
  • It gains temporary HP equal to twice its Level, once per encounter: inspiring it again renews the reroll only, and any temporary HP left are lost when the encounter ends.
  • The creature must hear the Bard and stay within 30ft.
  • 2 creatures at 11th level, 3 at 15th, 4 at 19th, with the same use.
